text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: When I saw the winner's face, I was really struck by how radiant she looked in her moment of victory…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I love seeing everyone's smiles, but… it's disappointing only being able to see them without getting to smile myself…
choice_data_list: Next time, people are going to be seeing you smile!
Let's work hard, so we'll be the ones grinning!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
choice_data_list: We can put a battle plan together after eating.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm going to work real hard after my stomach's nice and full!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe, okay. You're right. I'm going to do everything I can so we can smile too next time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay, no more moping! Here's to getting even stronger!
